successors.name: Shaishunaga dynasty
successors.text: Avanti with Vatsa: 'He conquered Avanti kingdom by defeating Nandivardhana or Avantivardhana, the last king of Pradyota dynasty'

ledger.x: c. 600 BCE: Avanti, ruled from Ujjayini with a southern seat at Mahishmati. Infobox 'Established c. 700 BCE', 'Capital Ujjayini'; 'the Haihayas were the earliest rulers of Avanti' from Mahishmati, and the last Vitihotra king Ripunjaya was overthrown by his minister Pulika, 'who put his son Pradyota on the throne'…

c. 450 BCE (undated): Vatsa passes under Avanti. 'Per the Kathasaritsagara, Vatsa was already part of Avanti under Palaka', Pradyota's successor, who 'ascended on the day of passing away of Mahavira' (Jain accounts); the year is Cliopatria's end of the Vatsa row (-451). c. 405 BCE: Shishunaga of Magadha destroys the Pradyota dynasty and takes Avanti. 'He conquered Avanti kingdom by defeating Nandivardhana or Avantivardhana, the last king of Pradyota dynasty'; 'He destroyed Pradyota dynasty of Avanti and conquered kingdoms of Kosala and Vatsa'; reign 'c. 413 - c. 395 BCE'. wars.name: Avanti-Vatsa war of Pradyota and Udayana
wars.outcome: Pradyota 'captured Vatsa king Udayana, then married his daughter Vasavadatta to Udayana'; no land changed hands then, but under Palaka 'Vatsa was already part of Avanti' (ledger -450).

wars.name: Pradyota's threat to Magadha
wars.outcome: No campaign recorded: Ajatashatru fortified Rajagriha 'to protect it from an invasion led by Pradyota' (Majjhima Nikaya).

wars.name: Pradyota's war with Pushkarasarin of Takshashila
wars.outcome: 'Pradyota waged war on Pushkarasarin, king of Takshashila'; the Gandhara (kingdom) page has Pukkusati 'successful in this struggle with Pradyota'.

wars.name: Shishunaga's conquest of Avanti
wars.outcome: Magadhan victory: the Pradyota dynasty destroyed and Avanti taken; 'The Magadhan victory must have been helped by the revolution that placed Aryaka on the throne of Ujjayini'.

certainty.note: The Vindhyas divide the two halves; no outer frontier is recorded, and the Vatsa addition from -450 rests on one undated sentence.
